relationships.subject: ZL006-05
relationships.evidence_quote: Intravenous injection of ZL006-05 dose-dependently alleviated RM-1-induced mechanical allodynia, heat hyperalgesia, cold hyperalgesia, and spontaneously ongoing nociceptive responses

relationships.subject: ZL006-05
relationships.evidence_quote: intravenous injection of ZL006-05 potentiated the GABA<sub>A</sub> receptor agonist-evoked currents in the neurons of the dorsal horn and anterior cingulate cortex

relationships.subject: ZL006-05
relationships.evidence_quote: also blocked the paclitaxel-induced increase in postsynaptic density-95-neuronal nitric oxide synthase interaction in dorsal horn

key_findings: Dual-target ZL006-05 alleviates bone cancer and paclitaxel neuropathic pain without tolerance
ZL006-05 potentiates GABAA currents in dorsal horn and ACC and blocks PSD-95-nNOS coupling
